assignments.value: Email revealed but no LinkedIn URL was returned, so company and designation could not be verified

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ access_token: $("Snov - Get Access Token").first().json.access_token, page: 1, filters: { prospect: { first_name: $json.first_name, last_name: $json.last_name }, company: { name: { include: [$json.current_company_name] } } } }) }}

parameters.content:
## Reveal -> verify -> re-search
1. Reveal email (1 credit; LinkedIn URL is masked until now)
2. LinkedIn check (1 credit): current company AND designation vs the record
3. Match -> verified lead. Same company, new title -> verified, title updated
4. Different company -> take current company/title from LinkedIn, search Snov.io again for that person there, reveal the new email (1 credit)
5. No match in the re-search -> Email Finder by name + domain (1-2 credits)
6. Unverified / no email / not found -> Review Queue
Polling loops retry up to 12 times.
